predecessors.name: Lazica
predecessors.text: Lazica (Egrisi) up to Cliopatria's last Lazica shape of 545

successors.name: Kingdom of Abkhazia
successors.text: Egrisi (Lazica), acquired by Leon II of Abasgia 'in the 770s'; the new polity 'continued to be called Egrisi (Lazica) in some chronicles'

ledger.x: 638: Lazica (Egrisi) reappears in the record as a Byzantine dependency.
724: the north-western strip passes to the Abasgians.
777: Leon II of Abasgia takes Lazica by dynastic union.

wars.name: Arab-Khazar wars
wars.outcome: The Arabs took Tiflis in 724 and Marwan ibn Muhammad pushed into Iberia and Abkhazia in c.

certainty.note: No page gives a boundary or an area; Cliopatria's shapes are approximate throughout.
